snip.t: ACE inhibitors block conversion of angiotensin‑I to angiotensin‑II, lowering systemic vascular resistance and glomerular filtration pressure.
Systemic vascular resistance: Falls about 30% (lowest at 20 weeks) — Improves blood flow to the uterus and placenta

Vasodilators: If systolic blood pressure remains adequate, start an intravenous nitrate infusion (glyceryl trinitrate) to unload the left ventricle by reducing systemic vascular resistance and pulmonary capillary wedge pressure.
Vasodilators such as nitrates decrease venous return and systemic vascular resistance, reducing LV chamber volume and worsening dynamic LVOT obstruction, which can cause syncope or arrest.
